title: Introduction to nethist
text: nethist package estimates network histograms single-layer multiplex (multi-layer) networks. network histogram partitions nodes network groups (bins) connectivity pattern groups approximates underlying graphon — generative probability function network. provides non-parametric, interpretable summary large network structure. package implements methods : Single-layer: Olhede & Wolfe (2014). Network Histograms Universality Blockmodel Approximation. PNAS, 111(41). Multi-layer: Song & Olhede (2026). Joint Estimation Sparse Multilayer Networks via Graph Limits. arXiv:2608.14536. package provides:

title: Introduction to nethist
text: nethist() accepts adjacency matrix, sparse dgCMatrix, igraph object. bandwidth parameter h (number bins) selected automatically specified. result nethist object following components: cluster: vector assigning node bin (integer labels 1 k) thetahat: k × k matrix estimated connection probabilities bins rho_hat: estimated overall network density normalized_LL: normalized profile log-likelihood solution quick example synthetic network:
code: set.seed(42) data(polblog)  # Automatic bandwidth selection nethist_polblog <- nethist(polblog) print(nethist_polblog) set.seed(2024) A_gnp <- igraph::sample_gnp(200, 0.05) result <- nethist(A_gnp) print(result) #>  #> Network histogram fit (nethist) #>  #> Nodes: 200   Blocks: 7   Bandwidth: 26 #> Method: Profile Likelihood #> thetahat: 7 x 7 probability matrix #> Normalized log-likelihood: -3.702484 #>  #> Use summary() for details.

title: Introduction to nethist
text: multinethist() accepts three-dimensional adjacency array size n × n × L, L number layers, list igraph objects. common_f argument controls whether common histogram function assumed across layers: fast illustrative example using synthetic data:
code: set.seed(42) data(IndianVil)  # IndianVil is a 231 x 231 x 12 adjacency array # representing 12 socioeconomic relationship types in an Indian village mnethist_result <- multinethist(IndianVil) print(mnethist_result) # Heterogeneous histogram (default): each layer has its own density mnethist_het <- multinethist(IndianVil, common_f = FALSE)  # Homogeneous histogram: shared structure, layer-specific density mnethist_hom <- multinethist(IndianVil, common_f = TRUE) set.seed(2024) # Build a small 2-layer network A1 <- igraph::as_adjacency_matrix(igraph::sample_gnp(80, 0.10), sparse = FALSE) A2 <- igraph::as_adjacency_matrix(igraph::sample_gnp(80, 0.05), sparse = FALSE) A_multi <- array(c(A1, A2), dim = c(80, 80, 2))  mn_result <- multinethist(A_multi) print(mn_result) #>  #> Multilayer network histogram fit (multinethist) #>  #> Nodes: 80   Blocks: 5   Bandwidth: 14   Layers: 2 #> Common graphon across layers: FALSE #> Method: Profile Likelihood #> thetahat: 5 x 5 x 2 probability array #> Normalized log-likelihood: -3.252586 #>  #> Use summary() for details.

title: Introduction to nethist
text: violin_netsummary() implements network summary statistic Maugis et al. (2017). estimates prevalence small subgraph patterns (v-shapes, triangles, squares, …) via vertex subsampling, draws violin plot. useful comparing topology estimated histogram original network, comparing networks different studies.  y-axis shows prevalence (proportion sampled subgraphs type), width violin reflects variability across subsamples. roughly flat distribution indicates Erdős–Rényi-like structure; peaked distributions suggest community degree-heterogeneous structure.
code: set.seed(2024) A_gnp <- igraph::sample_gnp(400, 0.05) violin_netsummary(A_gnp) #> Warning in violin_netsummary(A_gnp): 'violin_netsummary' is deprecated. #> Use 'netsummary_plot' instead. #> See help("Deprecated") #> Use n_rep = 574

title: Network Histograms
text: nethist estimates network histograms, blockmodel approximation graphon (Wolfe Olhede 2013) underlying network’s connectivity pattern, single-layer multilayer networks. implements profile-likelihood method Olhede Wolfe (2014) least-squares method Gao et al. (2015) single-layer networks, well multilayer extension Song Olhede (2026). package also provides tools bandwidth selection, diagnostic plots, covariate visualization. functions accept undirected simple graphs without self-loops either igraph objects adjacency matrices.

title: nethist 1.1.0
text: logLik(): new S3 method nethist, multinethist, hnethist objects. Returns unnormalized Bernoulli log-likelihood logLik object df nobs attributes, AIC() BIC() work directly fit. Use logLik(fit, normalized = TRUE) per-edge normalized value stored fit$normalized_LL. hnethist(): added examples help page. summary(): new S3 method nethist, multinethist, hnethist objects. Reports fit dimensions, edge density, log-likelihood degrees freedom, AIC, BIC, , hnethist, shape selection.

title: nethist 1.1.0
text: hnethist(): normalized_LL now divided number edges sum()/2, matching nethist() multinethist(). Previously divided sum(), reported values half size corresponding nethist() values. Model selection BIC unaffected. print() methods nethist, multinethist, hnethist now respect digits argument printing normalized likelihood mean squared error. netsummary_plot(): example using suggested package network now guarded requireNamespace(). logLik() multinethist fit collapses single block now reports correct degrees freedom. multinethist(): method = "LSE" multilayer input now raises error. Previously accepted silently, fit computed profile likelihood, returned object labelled "LSE".

title: nethist 1.1.0
text: fitted objects now inherit common base class, network_histogram: nethist fits class c("nethist", "network_histogram"), multinethist fits c("multinethist", "network_histogram"), hnethist fits c("hnethist", "nethist", "network_histogram"). Previously hnethist inherited nethist multinethist unrelated either. logLik() print() method summary objects defined network_histogram. summary.multinethist() summary.hnethist() extend base method NextMethod(). Methods whose behaviour depends layer dimension, namely plot(), plot3d(), fitted(), print(), remain specific subclasses. See ?"network_histogram-class" documented hierarchy. Code tests exact class vector, identical(class(fit), c("hnethist", "nethist")), needs updating. Use inherits() instead.

title: nethist 1.1.0
text: print() methods nethist, multinethist, hnethist now compact. identify fit report thetahat dimensions , instead printing whole probability matrix array, Available components listing dropped. detailed output moved new summary() methods. Use object$thetahat fitted() estimated probabilities.

title: nethist 1.1.0
text: nethist(), multinethist(), hnethist() now state help pages greedy search stochastic converges local optimum, set.seed() called immediately fit reproducible results. hnethist() additionally notes merging step draws stats::kmeans() starting centres stream, selected number shapes depends . @returns sections nethist(), multinethist(), hnethist() now state full class vector including network_histogram, multinethist() lists method field. Removed leftover prompt boilerplate polblog polblog_edgelist help pages, requested CRAN team. polblog polblog_edgelist examples now call igraph::delete_vertices() instead deprecated igraph::delete.vertices().

title: nethist 1.0.0
text: New implementation Song Olhede (2026+) multi-layer network histogram estimation. common_f option assumes common graphon across layers. Accepts wider range inputs: 3D array, list igraph/network objects, ergm.multi::combined_networks object. New method = "LSE" option, implementing Gao et al. (2015) single-layer network histograms. Now implemented single-layer wrapper around multinethist(). hnethist(): new hybrid network histogram method shape-based model selection. fitted(): new S3 method nethist multinethist objects.
